subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Misdemeanour
solution: The correct answer is** "Obedience."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Misdemeanour"** means a minor wrongdoing or misbehavior. (किसी के द्वारा किया गया कुछ बुरा या ग़लत आचरण; अपराध जो अधिक संगीन या गंभीर नहीं) • **Example**: *Every week, as children, we were beaten for some minor **misdemeanour**__.* • **"Obedience"** means compliance with someone's wishes or orders. (आज्ञाकारिता) __ • **Example**: *He demands unquestioning **obedience**__ from his soldiers.* • Therefore, **Obedience** is the most appropriate antonym of **Misdemeanour**. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Offence**, means a crime; an illegal action. (अपराध; गै़र-क़ानूनी काम) • **Option 2, Amalgamation**, means the action or process of combining or uniting. (एकीकरण; सम्मिश्रण) • **Option 4, Gullible**, means easily fooled or deceived. ((व्‍यक्ति) दूसरों पर शीघ्र विश्‍वास करने और अतएव धोखा खाने वाला; भोला-भाला) 31:Tbea, The correct answer is **"dormant."**
